name: Ashington Foodbank
short_description: Local foodbank providing emergency food support in Ashington
description: Provides emergency food parcels to residents in crisis. Part of the Newcastle West Foodbank Network. Open Wednesdays 10am-2pm.

name: Ashington Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Peoples Park with wildlife area
months: this garden has 25 plots and a wildlife pond. Regular community growing sessions every weekend.

name: Ashington Community Fridge
short_description: Community fridge at Ashington Community Centre
months: this fridge reduces food waste and helps families access free food. Open Monday-Friday 9am-5pm.
